How come there are monsters here?\nThey look different from the crystal monster...
W-what on earth is this place!\nIs a place with liqueur supposed to be this\ndangerous?!
Let's deal with these things first before we talk!\nVirgo, Libera, let's do this!\nYou should help us too!
Pelulu, you protect the sakura spirits!\nSherry, Cersier, please stay close to her!
A-al, alright.\nSince you two are invisible to me, just be careful\nwhen I swing my weapon!
I've cleared my area. What about you guys?
I think we're more or less done too...
But it's weird. I've never seen those monsters\nbefore. They kinda went berserk.
Can you feel it too?\nI sense something mysterious, or rather ghastly\naura coming from the top of the waterfall...
Something mysterious like what?\nIs it also the reason why there were monsters\nhere?
G-guys! What the hey are those?!
I dunno but we'd better stop them!
...Sherry, go to the top of the waterfall and find\nout what happens. I'll stay here with the others\nto hold the monsters off.
What?! Cersier, you know how to fight?
Not directly but...\nI can back you guys up.
Oh, alright if that's the case.
Adventurer, can you please wait here? You were let\ninto the sakura world from the beginning...I know\nyou can handle the thing that's trying to harm it.
I know we can suppress the ghastly aura simply by\nhaving you here at the upstream. So I want you to\nstay and weaken it as it gets washed away.
Besides, I want you to be ready to rescue Sherry\nat any time...We're counting on you.
Hey, what did the spirits tell you?
So they said you could handle the thing that's\ntrying to harm the sakura world? Hmm, maybe\nthey're right because...
You were the only one who could see the spirits\nright from the start. So, all we need to do is\nprotect this place, right?
There, there! Since we're here, we won't let\nanyone pass!
Cersier, Sherry, you can count on us!
Let's get this done quickly and we make a toast\nlater!
A-alright, we're counting on you guys...!
Sherry is back already?\nSo, how was it? Did she figure something out?
Uh, um...\nI found something that may be causing all of this,\nbut...
I, I don't know why but...I see Caylass' sword,\nthe Scarlet Sakura on the top of the waterfall...\nIt's probably the source of the ghastly aura.
You mean that dangerous sword?!\nWhy the heck is something like that up there?
A-anyway, we should go get it.\nBut, if it's just us...
Alright, Virgo, Libera, and I will watch this\nplace to ensure that no more monsters are\ncoming...Can we ask you to go get the sword?
Oh nooo~...Honestly, I don't really want anything\nto do with that thing, but because you're my\nvaluable customer, I don't think I can say no~.
I-I'm counting on you then.\nSherry, please show the way.
